By morning, the village was gone, but its people were warming their hands around his stove.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡的街口，昨夜的雨在柏油路上留下细碎银光。早餐铺拉起卷帘门，蒸汽先于人声醒来。清洁工推着车穿过树影，远处一辆出租车缓缓驶过。高楼间偶有窗口亮着，不知是谁刚刚归来，又是谁准备出发。天边渐渐发白，风里已有热豆浆的香气。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same steps on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule: when a box contains no more boxes, stop opening!"}
